senses.gloss: लुब् vt. 1P, 10U (pres. लुंबति, लुंबयति-ते) To harass, to torment.
लुब्ध (I) a. (f. ब्धा) 1. Covetous, greedy; 2. desirous of, longing for, (pp. of लुभ् q.v.).
लुब्ध (II) m. 1. A hunter; 2. a libertine.
लुब्ध (I) a. (f. ब्धा) 1. Covetous, greedy; 2. desirous of, longing for, (pp. of लुभ् q.v.).
लुब्धक m. 1. A hunter, लुब्धकधावरपिशुना निष्कारणवैरिणा जगति Bhartr.ii.61; 2. a greedy man; 3. a libertine; 4. the star Sirius; 5. a tiger.
